Accessibility

Keyboard controls, motion choices and ways to report an accessibility problem to AutixAI.

Updated 8 October 2026

Using the site

  • Use Tab and Shift+Tab to move between controls, and Enter or Space to activate them.
  • Use the “Skip to content” link to bypass navigation.
  • Use Escape to close the navigation or a dialog. Dialog controls keep keyboard focus within the open panel and return it on close.
  • Forms have visible labels, required-field instructions and written errors. Provide a phone number or email for an enquiry; both are not required.
  • The workflow film has controls, captions and a transcript.

Motion, zoom and readable content

The site respects your device’s reduced-motion preference, including a flat mobile card layout. You can also pause decorative motion for the current page in privacy settings. User-started videos keep their own playback controls. Text and controls are designed to remain readable as the layout adapts to smaller screens and zoom.

Report a barrier

If a control, page or form is difficult to use, prepare an accessibility help request or use the phone link in the footer. Share the page, the action you tried and your device or assistive technology if useful. Avoid including sensitive personal information.

We review accessibility as the website changes. This page describes the available features; it is not a claim of complete WCAG conformance or certification.
